title: Illustrated onboarding flows for staged deployments, version pinning & fallback policies
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Design a compact, scannable quickstart and onboarding asset set that teaches developers and product owners how to configure staged deployments (canary and A/B) and set up version pinning + fallback policies in Redwood Console. Focus on 3 learning moments: 1) initial setup (pin model versions and create a rollout), 2) monitoring & decision points (traffic split, health checks, rollback triggers), and 3) fallback configuration (policy examples and visual confirmation). Deliverables should include a hero flow diagram, 6 annotated screen mockups at responsive breakpoints, a compact one-page checklist for quickstart, and 3 short gif micro-interactions for docs and in-app help.
acceptance_criteria: Hero flow diagram clearly distinguishes Hosted/Dedicated/Private routing and shows fallback escalation order
Six annotated screens (Create rollout, Attach pin, Traffic split slider, Canary dashboard, Fallback policy editor, Success banner + audit trail) exported at 2x and 3x for docs
Micro-interactions (traffic slider, canary health sparkline, fallback auto-promote animation) exported as GIFs under 2MB each
Hand-off Figma file with component variants and tokens named for Console team
Copy blocks written for each screen and reviewed by PM and Docs
Accessibility: contrast and disabled states validated against WCAG 2.1 AA
Design review sign-off from PM (Marco Liu) and Eng lead (Liam O'Connor)
deliverables: PNG mockups: create-rollout, attach-pin, traffic-split, canary-dashboard, fallback-editor, success-audit (2x/3x)
Handoff notes (README) and token mapping for Console devs
